content: scikit-fda dimensionality reduction/exploratory: FPCA (functional PCA, sklearn-compatible transformer), FPLS (functional PLS, added v0.9.1), DiffusionMap (functional diffusion maps, added v0.10.0). Variable selection: MaximaHunting, RecursiveMaximaHunting, RKHSVariableSelection, MinimumRedundancyMaximumRelevance. Feature construction: FDAFeatureUnion, PerClassTransformer, LocalAveragesTransformer, OccupationMeasureTransformer, NumberCrossingsTransformer; functions: modified_epigraph_index, local_averages, occupation_measure, number_crossings. Depth measures: IntegratedDepth, BandDepth, ModifiedBandDepth, DistanceBasedDepth, OutlyingnessBasedDepth, ProjectionDepth, SimplicialDepth, StahelDonohoOutlyingness. Outlier detection: BoxplotOutlierDetector, MSPlotOutlierDetector, directional_outlyingness_stats. Summary statistics: mean, gmean, trim_mean, depth_based_median, geometric_median, fisher_rao_karcher_mean, cov, var, std. Visualization: GraphPlot, ScatterPlot, ParametricPlot, Boxplot, SurfaceBoxplot, Outliergram, MagnitudeShapePlot, ClusterPlot, ClusterMembershipLinesPlot, ClusterMembershipPlot, FPCAPlot.
